statement: Wii Balance Board page locates an unencrypted 32-byte block at 0xA40020–0xA4003F with per-corner big-endian 16-bit calibration samples for 0, 17 and 34 kg and a trailing four-byte CRC32. The CRC covers bytes 0x24–0x3B followed by 0x20–0x21 and 0x60–0x61, using reversed polynomial 0xEDB88320. Per-sensor load is estimated by interpolation between calibration anchors, then summed. This board-specific CRC does not establish a checksum rule for Nunchuk or Classic.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew pinned community documentation; no authenticated retail capture
applicability.scope: Wii Balance Board > Calibration Data. Source-only, not a physical acceptance result. Outside C5 scope; wii-gap-extension-calibration-checksum-unknown stays unknown for Nunchuk and Classic.
